title: What's on GitHub
lede: Public repositories with the code, the documentation and the design decisions in plain sight.

resume.title: Professional CV in LaTeX
resume.summary: Generates a CV in four profiles, two languages and two layout variants —16 PDFs in total— from a single source of truth, with invariants verified in CI and releases versioned by tag.

pension-estimator.title: IMSS pension estimator (Law 73)
pension-estimator.summary: A React Native and Expo app that estimates the old-age pension under Mexico's 1973 Social Security Law. An auditable eight-step calculation engine, each step carrying its formula and its legal basis; 116 tests; no backend and no telemetry.

portfolio.title: This portfolio
portfolio.summary: A bilingual site published on GitHub Pages with React, Vite and Tailwind. The content lives in a single module and is validated against the same source of truth as the CV.
